view: WITH projected_orders AS (SELECT id AS order_id, cid AS customer_id FROM orders) SELECT c.cid AS cid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM projected_orders AS o RIGHT JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.cid GROUP BY c.cid
metric: SELECT COUNT(o.order_id) AS matched FROM (SELECT id AS order_id, cid FROM orders) AS o RIGHT JOIN customers AS c ON o.cid = c.cid
